'''B. Kirkland''' was a criminal who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of criminals led by Kirkland undertook an operation, dubbed "Operation Split Dewback", to rob valuable artifacts. During the heist, the criminals had to fight a contingent of security forces because the security system was not [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] properly. Furthermore, a shipment stolen by the criminals&mdash;supposedly weapons&mdash;appeared to contain pieces of art. In any case the operation was considered successful.<ref name="SWG:MfKB" />
